title: Port chess engine GPU backend to ROCm
text: Ports a chess engine's CUDA neural-network backend to ROCm for AMD GPUs, adding attention-network layers and FP16 kernels, reaching over 2000 nodes per second on an integrated GPU.

title: Migrate thousands of Svelte 4 files to 5
text: Migrates thousands of UI files from one major framework version to the next in a six-hour unattended run driven by a long prompt, followed by two days of QA that surfaced one bug.

title: Debug async database connections in Django
text: Hunts a database-connection bug in an async Django streaming app across four days and 1,427 lines of investigation notes, narrowing 63 suspicious connections down to the 10 that mattered.

title: Build HTTP benchmark tool, then refactor
text: Writes a programmable HTTP benchmarking tool in C with an embedded JavaScript engine in about 2,000 lines in a day, then refactors it commit by commit after finding silently failing fetch calls.

title: Rewrite FFmpeg codecs in Rust
text: Rewrites FFmpeg's codecs incrementally in Rust, leaning on the codec specifications and existing behavior to check each piece, after first rewriting smaller Python tooling in Rust.

title: Onboard to messy React and Node repo
text: Onboards to a messy old React and Node repository by asking for an architecture summary, how authentication works, and which data tables live in a given folder.

title: Fix Postgres extension after breaking change
text: Fixes a PostgreSQL extension for a query language after a dependency's breaking change blocked support for Postgres 17, working over three nights around parenting duties.

title: Find bug in shelved Go delay queue
text: Searches a shelved twelve-year-old Go delay-queue library, built on a write-ahead log and sorted heap, for the bug that had stalled the project, reviving it.

title: Upgrade fork and reapply custom changes
text: Upgrades a forked open-source library to its latest release and reapplies the fork's custom changes on top of the new version.

title: Diagnose PHP static-analysis crash
text: Tracks down why a PHP static-analysis tool crashes on a company codebase, finding which code constructs trigger its invalid internal state before filing a bug report.

title: Scan open-source repos for vulnerabilities
text: Scans a maintainer's open-source repositories for security issues and surfaces subtle vulnerabilities that stay hidden until explained, which are then fixed.

title: Port untyped Python to Java
text: Ports a set of untyped Python functions to equivalent Java methods for a critical service rewrite, inferring parameter types and which functions are active.

title: Migrate scientific code from CPU to GPU
text: Migrates a scientific code base from CPU-only to GPU computation, running a range of experiments and converging on a workable architecture.

title: Reproduce XML library in Rust from tests
text: Reproduces an unmaintained C XML parsing library in Rust by working until its existing test suites pass, after similar trials on a key-value store and an embedded database.

title: Translate LAPACK from Fortran to C11
text: Translates a Fortran 77 linear algebra library into C11, with help on selected tasks, so users can avoid a Fortran dependency.

title: Rust replacement for Svelte type-checker
text: Builds a Rust drop-in replacement for a Svelte type-checker that transforms components to TSX in parallel, cutting a 650-file monorepo check from 39 to 1.3 seconds.

title: Migrate repos between code hosts
text: Migrates hundreds of repositories from one code host to another and rewrites their CI pipelines automatically, applying coordinated changes across an entire company codebase.

title: Port runtime from Zig to Rust
text: Ports a production JavaScript runtime from Zig to Rust, producing a million lines in under two weeks while the existing test suite passes in CI before merge.

title: Migrate Python codebase to TypeScript
text: Migrates a Python codebase to 165,000 lines of TypeScript over a weekend, diffing every command's output against the original as a final parity check.

title: Rewrite Linux cached-file read path
text: Rewrites the Linux page-cache read path, with code, tests and review attributed to a coding tool, tripling small-read throughput on a personal test machine.

title: Rewrite Python effects library in Rust
text: Rewrites a Python terminal text-effects library in Rust in one pass, cutting startup from 87ms to 2ms and speeding rendering 9.6 times with zero dependencies.

title: Upgrade Rust dependency in WASM code
text: Upgrades a Rust dependency across very custom WebAssembly code in over thirty iterations, consulting library documentation and a language-server tool along the way.

title: Debug terminal UI redraw bug
text: Reads a terminal app's own minified source alongside its UI library's repository to deduce why the screen redraws repeatedly when input exceeds the terminal height.

title: Write Zig upgrade guide for code updates
text: Writes a language guide for a newer Zig release listing differences from older versions, so dependency and code updates need no hand edits.

title: Document a 500k-line codebase
text: Documents a 500,000-line codebase in about an hour, covering how it works, local setup, legacy nuances, and deployment through salt-stack to AWS.

title: Generate test data for C codec function
text: Generates dummy input data for unit tests of a C audio-codec function by extracting it with its dependencies into a self-contained program under 200 lines.

title: Plan large refactor across a codebase
text: Plans a large cross-codebase refactor by writing how things currently work, the target shape and a migration path, then reuses that plan in fresh sessions to save tokens.

title: Migrate WordPress sites to Next.js
text: Migrates several WordPress sites to Next.js on Netlify, producing audits for search ranking, conversion, accessibility and schema markup along the way.

title: Hunt SwiftUI memory leak
text: Analyzes a small SwiftUI app with memory-inspection tools and looped runs to find a slow virtual-memory leak that grows tens of megabytes a day, without locating it.

title: Finish stalled Flash app HTML5 port
text: Completes a long-stalled HTML5 port of a 28-year-old Flash app over a single weekend without first redocumenting its codebase.

title: Migrate legacy APIs over seven months
text: Migrates 2,888 of 2,913 APIs from a 20-year-old legacy system to a new architecture over seven months at about half the cost of a conventional rebuild.

title: Find 23-year-old Linux NFS bug
text: Scans the Linux kernel source for security vulnerabilities and finds a remotely exploitable NFS bug that had been present for about 23 years.

title: Security-audit an open-source CLI toolkit
text: Audits an open-source command-line toolkit with separate reviewers, cross-referencing findings against existing community issues to leave 16 new security problems.

title: Handle dependency upgrades in sessions
text: Handles dependency upgrades in short sessions, treating major version bumps separately after an ORM upgrade passed tests but broke an uncovered code path.

title: Port geometry fillet fix behind opt-in flag
text: Ports a geometry-kernel fix from a fork so a fillet trace starting at a tangent point runs along the curve instead of across it, behind a new opt-in flag.

title: Test the unreadable-template refusal branch
text: Adds a read-failure seam to a template store so the previously untestable branch refusing a template that cannot be read gets pinned by a test.

title: Stop silent duplicate cell records
text: Changes a report-table planner to stop with an error naming the row key when two records share one cell, instead of silently keeping the first.

title: Size VM disk requests from their disks
text: Sizes virtual-machine disk requests and provisioning tickets from the VM's own disks in a datacenter placement service, alongside companion changes in two sibling repositories.

title: Add Postgres extension support to init resource
text: Adds an optional extensions property to a database-initialization cloud resource so stacks install Postgres extensions such as pgvector on create and update.

title: Add year facet and full-text records search
text: Adds a year facet and full-text search over PDF files to a public records page, shipping the full-text search switched off behind a flag.

title: Search chat transcripts from command palette
text: Adds transcript search to a chat app's command palette so a conversation can be found by something said halfway through, not only by its title.

title: Test every permission route has restricted row
text: Adds an end-to-end test checking that every permission-gated route has a row for a restricted user, plus a phase for personal presets.

title: Plot alert probabilities on forecast week
text: Moves each plotted probability in a crop weed alert chart onto the week it forecasts instead of the date it was issued.

title: Backport Helm job to publish new schema
text: Backports a Helm chart change so a job publishes a new object-type version when the chart's schema changed, porting it from one release line to another.

title: Half-resolution ambient occlusion in renderer
text: Computes enhanced ambient occlusion at half resolution in a Rust game renderer, using a texture half the view size rounded up.

title: Build only listed chart types
text: Restricts a chart-spec builder to build only the listed chart types for sensors and assets, leaving chart defaults untouched.

title: Make SDK a peer dependency
text: Changes two protocol SDK packages from exact dependencies to peer dependencies pinned to one minor version, so consumers install the SDK themselves.

title: Fix password change then consent session
text: Fixes an authorization flow so a forced password change followed by a consent screen opens a new browser session instead of returning to login.

title: Keep drawer scroll when ticking filter default
text: Fixes a designer drawer so ticking a filter's default value keeps scroll position and focus, after a page reload was rebuilding the interface.

title: Narrow TeX file watcher to document files
text: Narrows a TeX engine's file watcher to the document's own files so an ancestor directory counts only its own events, shortening the compile restart find phase.

title: Split complex resolver into tested steps
text: Splits an overly complex corpus-query resolver method into separate steps, each with its own test, to satisfy static quality and security checks.

title: Speed up TLS gRPC with bulk copies
text: Profiles a TLS gRPC echo, finds about 72 percent of time in element-wise sequence operations, and replaces them with bulk memory copies and fewer wakeups.

title: Update batcher complaint term on decisions
text: Fixes a consensus batcher so the term it signs complaints with updates on every decision, not only when the primary changes.

title: Pin CI action versions with hashes
text: Pins an action's installed linter to exact versions with hashes and updates them through Dependabot, so a new release no longer changes every consumer's CI at once.

title: Add Rust workspace for Go migration
text: Adds a Cargo workspace, dependency-deny policy and CI jobs as the Rust build foundation for a version-two migration beside the unchanged Go module.

title: Add cache bypass to edge worker
text: Adds a test-only cache bypass to an edge worker, via an environment flag or a tokened query parameter, so requests skip cache reads and writes.

title: Load realm quotas from YAML config
text: Fixes an identity server so realm quotas load from the YAML configuration, as the spec documents, and counts keys only.

title: Read CLI output line by line in CMake
text: Changes a build integration to read CLI output line by line instead of as a CMake list, fixing breakage when a board parameter contains a semicolon.

title: Check auth before disabled-route 405
text: Makes disabled realm-admin routes check authentication before answering 405, so unauthenticated callers cannot probe which endpoints exist.
